subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252 to be rebased, or replace/adopt it with a narrow target-repository fix?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but an open cross-repo closing PR already claims the issue and is conflicting plus non-maintainer-modifiable, so automation should not silently open a competing fix without maintainer intent.

options.title: Replace the uneditable PR
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository PR, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after a replacement exists.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase
options.body: Keep the issue paired with the open fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it with maintainer edits enabled if possible.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave the issue and fork PR open while accepting that the source-reproducible leak remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Replace the uneditable PR
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository PR, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after a replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current and historical signal on the shared stripper and TUI display boundary involved in this routing choice.
